Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: In the final step, the Planner misattributed the directors to the wrong films (assigning Giuseppe Vari to Dallas 362 and Scott Caan to Revenge of the Barbarians) and thus concluded that Revenge of the Barbarians had the younger director. This contradicts the correctly gathered facts earlier (Scott Caan, born 1976, directed Dallas 362; Giuseppe Vari, born decades earlier, directed Revenge of the Barbarians).
